artworks.title: Sir William Sanderson
artworks.description: The image is a portrait engraving of a man's upper body. He has long hair, prominent facial features, and is wearing 17th-century clothing with a white collar. The portrait is set within an oval frame with intricate lines and shading. Below the portrait is text including the man's name, age, and a Latin quote. The background has a lined pattern.

artworks.title: Sir William Sanderson
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing an upper body portrait of a man, depicted from the chest up. The man has long, wavy hair that extends past his shoulders and a full beard and mustache. He is wearing a dark garment with a white collar and an adornment around his neck. The background consists of dense, parallel lines. Beneath the portrait is a rectangular area containing text.

artworks.title: Christopher Chelys Simpson
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring a portrait of a man from the chest up. The man faces slightly to his left with his gaze directed towards the viewer. He has long, wavy hair, a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a mustache. He wears a dark coat with broad lapels and a wide, white collar. The oval frame surrounding the man's portrait is elaborate, and below the portrait is a coat of arms with a lion and a Latin phrase. The background of the engraving is filled with densely hatched lines for texture, and the artwork is bordered by a rectangular frame with inscriptions at the bottom.

artworks.title: Christopher Chelys Simpson
artworks.description: The image displays an engraved portrait of a person in a front-facing seated position. He has long, wavy hair, a mustache, a pronounced nose, a high forehead, and a solemn expression. He is dressed in a dark-colored, buttoned-up garment with a high, ruffled collar and a bow or cravat. The background features a textured, hatched pattern, and below the oval frame, there is an emblem with a lion and the Latin phrase "LUXE LUX SINE UMBRA." Inscribed below is the name "Christophori Simpson Effigies."

artworks.title: Christopher Chelys Simpson
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man depicted from the chest up within an oval frame. The man is positioned facing slightly to his left, with his head turned toward the viewer. His facial features include a long, prominent nose, thin lips, and a thoughtful expression, with noticeable cheekbones and a slight furrow in his brow. He has shoulder-length, wavy hair that flows outwards. He is dressed in what appears to be 17th-century attire, featuring a broad, white collar with a central decorative element over a dark garment. The background is a textured pattern, creating a contrast with the smooth appearance of his face and clothing. Below the oval frame, there is a decorative shield with a lion emblem and a Latin inscription, framed by a ribbon. The background does not feature any distinct elements.

artworks.title: Melchisedec de Thevenot
artworks.description: The image depicts a man standing upright facing slightly to the left. One hand is resting on a table holding a map and a globe, while the other hand is tucked into his garment. The man has an oval face with defined facial features, including a prominent nose and slightly pursed lips. He wears a turban on his head and a long robe with trimmed sleeves. The background includes detailed drapery. Beside him is a table with a globe and a map, with visible words like "Arabie" and "Arabian." The table's side displays a coat of arms with shields.

artworks.title: James Ussher, D.D.
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man seated and facing slightly to his right. He has distinctive features including prominent cheekbones, a pointed nose, a mustache, and a small beard. He wears a cap, a formal dark robe, and an elaborate ruff collar. The portrait is surrounded by an ornate oval frame with inscriptions. Below the portrait is a decorative element with a coat of arms or emblem. The background features lined and textured decorations.

artworks.title: Sir Francis Vere
artworks.description: This is a monochromatic engraving showing a portrait of a man in profile facing right. The man has a strong facial profile with a prominent nose and chin and short, slicked-back hair. He is wearing ornate armor with decorative elements and a ruffled collar. Elaborate designs, including various patterns and possibly a knotted cord, adorn the armor. The background consists of a dark, textured oval frame enclosing the man, with a banner above that reads "MEDIO ET TEMPORE." The portrait is within an elegant frame with the name "Sr Francis Vere" inscribed at the bottom.

artworks.title: Sir Horace Vere
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man in upper-body portrait. He is seated facing forward with his head slightly turned to the right. The man has short, dark hair and features including a sharp nose, small lips, and a prominent chin. He has a neutral expression and is wearing armor with rivets and a large ruffled collar. There are no visible accessories or objects in his hands. The background has a cross-hatching pattern for texture. The portrait is enclosed in an oval frame with the words "VERO NIHIL VERIUS" above and a caption that reads: "Sr. HORACE VERE since Baron of Tilbury" below.

artworks.title: Vincent Voiture
artworks.description: The image displays an engraved portrait of a man. He is shown from the chest up, slightly angled to his right, with long wavy hair falling to his shoulders and a pronounced mustache. His oval-shaped face features a prominent forehead, arched eyebrows, and a serious expression. He wears a dark, buttoned garment with a visible white shirt collar and a ribbon-tied cravat. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background consists of engraved lines forming an oval frame around the portrait, set against a textured rectangular border. Below the portrait is a poem or text within the engraving.

artworks.title: Vincent Voiture
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the chest up, with long wavy hair falling to his shoulders. He has a mustache and small goatee, wearing a dark buttoned garment with a high white collar and lace or ruffle details at the neck. The background has a textured, lined pattern in an oval shape, against a lighter background. Below the image, there is a block of text in a stylized script font, including a poem and the name "R: Lovelace."

artworks.title: Sir George Wharton
artworks.description: The image shows an oval portrait of a person depicted from the shoulders up, facing slightly to the left but looking directly at the viewer with a composed expression. The individual has long, wavy hair that falls past the shoulders, with a smooth texture and slight parting near the forehead. Their facial features include a defined jawline, full lips, and softly arched eyebrows above open eyes that gaze steadily outward. They are dressed in a draped garment resembling historical attire, with visible folds and pleats adding texture to the clothing. The background features a crosshatched pattern within a dark oval frame, and below the portrait is a decorative border containing an inscription in elegant, cursive lettering. The engraving style adds a classic and detailed appearance to the portrait.

artworks.title: Title Page to Thomas Blount, The Academy of Eloquence
artworks.description: The image shows four historical figures in ornate oval frames. From the top left, the figures are "Demosthenes," facing right, "Cicero," facing left, a central child-like figure holding a cloth labeled "THE Academy of Eloquence By Tho: Blount Esq;" below, "Fr: Lo: Bacon," and "Sr: Ph. Sidney." The figures are surrounded by a lined, architectural design.

artworks.title: The Creation of Animals
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a scene combining celestial and terrestrial elements. The image features a sky with a sun, moon, stars, clouds, and a face emitting wind. Below the sky are rolling hills, a building resembling a church or castle, and a figure in ornate attire gesturing towards various animals including a deer, elephant, crocodile, and birds. The scene implies a connection to nature or the animal kingdom. The image also includes astrological symbols and lightning bolts, suggesting themes of cosmic significance and natural philosophy. The text "HISTORIA NATVRÆ" is present at the bottom border.

artworks.title: Title Page to The Edward Chamberlayne, The Present State of England
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals. The central figure is seated on a throne, adorned with a crown and regal attire. The person to the left holds a scepter, while the one on the right holds a large book. The backdrop is richly decorated with patterns and panels. At the bottom, there is an inscription framed in an ornate design.

artworks.title: Title Page to Sir Dudly Digges, The Compleat Ambassador
artworks.description: Three figures are depicted in a full-length view in a regal or formal setting. The central figure is seated on an ornate throne, wearing a crown and holding a scepter. Her robe is elaborate and she appears to have curly hair styled in an elegant updo. The figure on the left is standing and wearing a decorated robe and hat, holding a square flat object with a design on it. The figure on the right is also standing and dressed in a richly detailed garment, holding a scroll in his hand. The background features draped curtains, a textured backdrop, and a decorative emblem above the seated figure. An inscription below describes the subject as the "Compleat Ambassador."

artworks.title: Title Page to Jeremy Taylor, The Great Exemplar
artworks.description: The engraving shows a depiction of a woman, a child, multiple adult figures, and several symbolic elements. At the center, a woman and a child are shown from waist up. The woman is holding the child. The child has curly hair. Both figures are surrounded by a halo and embraced by an angel from above. Above them, a cherubic face watches from below. Surrounding this central image are multiple square panels featuring different scenes: the top left and right panels depict elderly figures with long hair and beards, engrossed in writing or reading. Directly below the top left figure is a round inset showing a divine or spiritual figure in light amid clouds, while the middle bottom left and right panels exhibit similar elder figures. On the right, there is a scene with a cross labeled 'INRI,' surrounded by symbolic elements such as a skull and lightning. All these components are framed with decorative details and placed on a backdrop of engraved text, patterns, and engravings depicting religious and symbolic iconography, including a crown and angelic faces.

artworks.title: Title Page to the Work of Homer, Translated by Thomas Hobbes
artworks.description: The illustration features a bust of Homer at the top, flanked by two soldiers in armor holding spears. Below is an inscription for "The Workes of Homer" by T. Hobbes. In the center bottom is a portrait of Thomas Hobbes. The background is ornately engraved with the publisher's information stating "London Printed for W: Crooke at the green Dragon, without Temple Barre. 1677."

artworks.title: Dr. William Davison, Scotch Chemist and Physician in Paris
artworks.description: The image shows a man positioned facing forward but with his head slightly turned to the left. He has a mustache and long, curly hair. He has a calm expression and is wearing period clothing. The background features an intricately designed oval frame with text and below it, a coat of arms with a helmet, shield, and decorative elements. The background is detailed and textured.

artworks.title: John Dethick
artworks.description: This image is a portrait of a man from the chest up. He is seated or in a slightly oblique position. The man has distinctive features such as a neat beard and mustache. His hair, under a cap, is short and slightly curled. He is wearing formal historical attire with ornate buttons and a large collar around his neck. There are no visible jewelry pieces. The background has a line-etched pattern, framed by an oval border with embellishments and inscriptions at the bottom, including a coat of arms.

artworks.title: John Donne, Poet
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body in an oval frame. The man is facing forward with curly, shoulder-length hair and a full beard. He has deep-set eyes and wears draped fabric resembling classical garments. The background features a patterned design. Below the oval frame, there is an adorned banner with text.

artworks.title: Sir Samuel Morland, Diplomatist and Inventor
artworks.artist: Pierre Lombard after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man. He is shown in a three-quarter view, facing slightly to the left. The man has long, wavy hair and facial features including a prominent nose, rounded chin, full lips, and a contemplative gaze. He is dressed in a dark coat with visible buttons and a white collar. The portrait is framed by an ornate, oval border, and the background has a textured pattern. Below the portrait, there is a crest with text.

artworks.title: Alexander, Chaplain to Charles I, Author
artworks.description: The image features a man seated at a desk. He has a beard, mustache and medium length wavy hair. He is wearing a robe with billowing sleeves and a collar. He is holding a pen and there is an open book on the desk. The background shows detailed bookshelves filled with books and two globes on either side of him.

artworks.title: Alexander Ross, Chaplain to Charles I
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man identified as Alexander Ross, depicted from the waist up seated behind a desk. His arms are resting on an open book, and he holds a quill in his right hand. He has a full beard and mustache, wavy shoulder-length hair, and prominent facial features. Ross is dressed in an academic or ecclesiastical robe with a ruffled white collar. The background features a detailed library setting with shelves of books, drawn curtains, and two globes in front of his desk.
